segments.text: naughty an open-source note taking app that seamlessly combines Simplicity artificial intelligence and Powerful
markdown editing nauy is all about Simplicity crafted with a minimalistic design it provides an intuitive and
clutter free user experience allowing you to focus on what matters most your thoughts and ideas but what sets nauy apart is its AI
powered capabilities leveraging the open router API NY assists you in writing better notes and documents adding a layer of
intelligence to your writing process NTI comes equipped with a built-in markdown editor formatting your
notes has never been easier worried about accessibility across devices fear not Nati's Cloud sync feature ensures
your notes are seamlessly synchronized providing you with accessibility and continuity across your workflow nauy prioritizes a local first
approach meaning your data is stored on your device and can be optionally stored in the cloud for added convenience speaking of the tech behind
NTI it runs on next JS for the front end cloudflare workers for the back end cloudflare KV for the database and open
router API for its AI capabilities
